author: AtomiCancer
quote: Man… at the beginning of the game you feel like this is going to be game of the year. The graphics, the radio music and stations (obviously Cocoteo being the best one), the attention to detail on how the npc’s react. Makes you say “bro, this is it. They have done it”. But sadly, when you are past the honey moon face the game is just plain boring… you come to understand that there is nothing actually new or innovative about this game, is just a plain big world rpg set in the modern age. Sad, I remember playing and having a blast with the characters in GTA 5. But in this game the characters are just meh and even the story is meh. Red dead 2 did it so much better, Red dead 2 really did knew what it was doing. What happend through these 13 years? We dint even get a disc… we dont even own this game. Sad, sad, sad.

author: AtomiCancer
quote: The best starting point for The Legend Of Zelda games. Nintendo just made the best game ever created even better. The legend of Zelda OOTR has just made history once again bringing old school gameplay to a modern time and made a beautiful remake. Thank you, Nintendo. Now kids from this age can see and understand when we say that  games today are not made with the same passion and love as they were. But only Nintendo can bring this back. Keep it up. Show this people how its done.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: AtomiCancer
quote: Splatoon Raiders has been the most addicting game by far in 2026. Nintendo just keeps giving us some very promising games. Very fun, very recommended. Nothing else, buy it. No regrets.

author: AtomiCancer
quote: WOW. No pense que un juego inspirado en los juegos de nintendo me iba hacer sentir como la saga de “The legend of Zelda”  me hace sentir. Bestia de juego lo recomiendo al 100 si eres fan de Zelda o te gustan ese tipo de juegos. Must have. Must play. Si solo pudiera callar por completo a la fairy. Este juego fuera 10/10.
game_title: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales

author: AtomiCancer
quote:
Es increible que juegos como estos puedan correr tan bien en una consola tan delgada como es la switch 2. No tan solo eso, la diferencia gráfical no es tan significativa como eran los ports del switch 1. Me alegra tanto que compañias como Square Enix le están metiendo empeño a lanzar sus juegos en sin dispositivo portátil. 

Por otro lado, FF7 Rebirth a logrado expandir la historia de los personajes que tanto queremos de varios años atrás. El juego trae nuevas dinámicas que son muy entretenidas y un catalogo de musica excelente. No puedo esperar a obtener el proximo y ultimo de la saga FF7. Excelente port, lo único malo es el agua... Esto estoy seguro que se puede mejorar con una actualización.
